news.title:
Info Edge posted Q3 revenue of INR 7.6bn, up 14% y/y, with 11.8% growth in billings.
Operating profit rose to INR 3bn with a 300bp margin expansion; stock fell 23.1% in 12 months.

Info Edge posted Q3 revenue of INR 7.6bn, up 14% y/y, with 11.8% growth in billings.
